title.narrative: Support to External Technical Agency on Tackling Deadly Diseases in Africa Programme

description.narrative: This activity Support to External Technical Agency on Tackling Deadly Diseases in Africa Programme is a component of Tackling Deadly Diseases in Africa Programme reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £16,473,731. This project benefits Africa, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Infectious disease control, Health policy and administrative management, Health education, Health personnel development.
